Body.Content:
People using Outlook for iOS on iPhone and iPad will see refreshed interface elements aligned with the latest Liquid Glass iOS visual experience, including modernized app chrome, navigation, and use of screen space. It will be enabled by default with no administrator action required.

GA date: September CY2026
